paraphrase: Use location only where it is directly relevant to the app's features, notify the user and obtain consent before collecting, transmitting or using location data, explain the purpose in the app, and do not build emergency services or autonomous control of vehicles, aircraft or other devices on location APIs (small devices like toys, lightweight drones and car-alarm remotes excepted).
quote: Location-based APIs shouldn't be used to provide emergency services
